integrity: Complete analytic inverse proof from previously published corner-moment laws; an exact 3-4-5 reconstruction is a diagnostic. No formal/expert verification is implied.
scientific_limitations: Only a fixed nondegenerate triangle with separately known perimeter and exact first two population moments of the limiting area deficit. The forward polygon corner-product law and exponentially accurate mean correction are previously published and not independently claimed. No noisy finite-data inversion or degenerating-shape stability.
title: Two limiting area-deficit moments reconstruct a triangle with known perimeter
